R1_analytic_head.assets: REUSES accepted S2 D1 (identity) ridge W/b — 0 new fits, 0 new PCA
R1_analytic_head.prediction: logits = val_joint(f64) @ W + b over canonical seen columns; argmax ties -> smallest id
R1_analytic_head.test_stage: test features generated only in the sealed evaluation stage

R2_pca16_readout.primary_contrast: vs S1 head; SECONDARY paired R2-R1 isolates the PCA effect
R2_pca16_readout.assets: REUSES accepted S2 D3 PCA mean/components and its ridge W/b — 0 new fits
R2_pca16_readout.ordering_rule: pseudo features are generated in the ORIGINAL joint space first; the SAME PCA transform is then applied to real+pseudo rows; centroids are never pre-projected before nearest-source selection
R2_pca16_readout.dim_note: 16 fixed by S2 pre-registration; no per-dataset view switching
R2_pca16_readout.naming_note: PCA readout diagnostic; NOT a reproduction of EASE/CONCIL

LN_layernorm_injection.wiring: subclass of the real classifier; nn.LayerNorm(48, eps=1e-5, elementwise_affine=True) applied to the encoder SEQUENCE, then the ORIGINAL attention formula
LN_layernorm_injection.non_identity_note: gamma=1/beta=0 still changes values because normalization precedes the affine
LN_layernorm_injection.centroids: candidate-own (its Task1 representation); S1 centroids not reused

POOL_mean_pooling.wiring: subclass; temporal attention module REMOVED; representation = mean over time; latent 48, joint 56

C1_backbone_freeze.question: Task1 TRAINING DEPTH contrast (not incremental unfreezing)
C1_backbone_freeze.init: same-seed UNTRAINED CfC initialization (not an S1 checkpoint)

C2_gru_backbone.wiring: encoder replaced by nn.GRU(48, 1 layer, unidirectional, batch_first) returning the FULL sequence; SAME baseline attention formula on that sequence; latent 48, joint 56
C2_gru_backbone.comparison_note: same seed/protocol performance comparison; parameter and compute differences reported

attention_formula_baseline: scores = temporal_attention(torch.tanh(sequence)); weights = softmax(scores, dim=time); rep = sum(weights * sequence)

screening.measure: candidate final-task ALL-seen validation macro minus the same-seed S1 saved-head validation macro
screening.s1_reference_spec: S1 saved float32 head weights/bias; S2 float32 val joint; batch 256; CUDA float32 linear; columns = canonical seen ascending; argmax ties -> smallest id
screening.failure_state: SCREEN_FAIL with the 3 diffs, reason and budget; no zero fill, no df7, not mechanism-failure evidence
screening.test_isolation: test is read only after training + selection are sealed

statistics.main_matrix: 8-seed cells: two-sided paired t95 (df7), NOMINAL interval
statistics.holm_formula: p_adj(i) = min(1, max_{j<=i} [(24 - j + 1) * p_(j)]) over the r cells that actually reached 8 seeds, sorted ascending
statistics.null_rule: cells without 8 seeds: raw and adjusted p are null; no rejection claim
statistics.scope_note: these describe the fixed seed sample only; not population inference

s4.primary_quantity: per-dataset endpoint range_4 mean over 8 seeds vs per-dataset R1 and R2 endpoint test macro paired gain mean over 8 seeds
s4.test: Spearman rho across the 4 datasets with AVERAGE RANKS for ties; constant variable -> rho null, status UNDEFINED_CONSTANT
s4.hypothesis: higher sensitivity tends to co-occur with larger readout-candidate gain (EXPLORATORY, descriptive)
forbidden: mixing R2-R1 into the 24-item confirmatory family

statistics.baseline_A_gate: reported per its original registered definition, with the multiple-comparison correction listed alongside

execution.process_split: torch and numpy compute must run in SEPARATE processes on this machine (libiomp/MKL clash); no KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK
measure: hook-counted forwards incl. the original head

s2_negative_result_preserved: W/B = 1.0312387176, strict W<B FAIL, descriptive downgrade

aggregation.paired_gain: candidate_test_macro − SAME-SEED S1 accepted test macro (subtract first, then statistics)
aggregation.screen_fail: main p and CI are null; 3-seed screen is not 8-seed evidence
aggregation.s4: endpoint range_4 8-seed mean vs readout gain 8-seed mean, Spearman across 4 datasets, average ranks, constant -> rho null/UNDEFINED_CONSTANT
aggregation.range_check: every accuracy must be finite and within [0,1]; otherwise the run fails

lifecycle.training: seeds 11/22/33 only until PROMOTED; then the remaining five
lifecycle.seal: all 24 terminal, exact seed sets, asset hashes re-verified
lifecycle.evaluate: seal + protocol + every asset hash re-verified before any test read
